abilities.name: Kurage's Oath

effects.attribution: C2: The Clouds Like Waves Rippling

_curatorNotes: Bake-Kurage tick heal authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on the Bake-Kurage summon (Kuki Sanctifying Ring shape). gcsim skill.go: first tick at skillHitmark=24f (= spawnsAt, immediate on jellyfish spawn), then every 120f (2s) for 7 total ticks over the ~12.5s status (kokomiskill = 12*60+30+1 = 751f). firstTickDelay: 0 (immediate first tick — differs from the summonTick interval-default). Heal targets c.Core.Player.Active() → target 'active'. TL10: skillHealPct[9]=0.0792 (7.92% Max HP) + skillHealFlat[9]=932.22455 (sidecar 'Regeneration' col 10 = '7.9% Max HP+932').

Bake-Kurage Ripple DMG tick authored alongside as a summonTick damage effect (kuki heal+damage pair shape). The skillTick pulse handles both damage and heal, so the trigger is identical to the heal's. TL10: skillDmg[9]=1.965427 → 196.54% ATK (sidecar 'Ripple DMG' col 10 = 196.5%), Hydro, ICDTag None. NOTE: Bake-Kurage base DMG scales on ATK, not HP (sidecar Ripple DMG row lacks the 'Max HP' suffix; createSkillSnapshot carries no HP scaling) — a known Kokomi quirk. NOT authored on the damage tick: the burstDmgBonus FlatDmg (Ceremonial Garment '+Bake-Kurage DMG based on Max HP'), which applies only while the burst is active — that belongs to the still-unauthored Ceremonial Garment buff (see burst _curatorNotes).

C2 (The Clouds Like Waves Rippling) heal add-on: gcsim skill.go lines 111-118 resolve the C2 node's flagged shape ambiguity — the +4.5% Max HP is a heal-AMOUNT add (src += 0.045*maxhp) gated on the active char's HP ratio ≤ 0.5, i.e. a second heal effect scaling 4.5 on hp with conditions constellation:2 + recipientHpBelow:50. Left on the C2 constellation node (out of scope for this skill-heal finding) but documented here so the C2 node can be fixed.

nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim kokomi/skill.go:40 — the f24 hit is the jellyfish's FIRST tick, queued from the cast; the Bake-Kurage series carries it.
abilities.description:
Summons a "Bake-Kurage" created from water that can heal her allies.
Using this skill will apply the Wet status to Sangonomiya Kokomi.

Bake-Kurage
Deals Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and heals nearby active characters at fixed intervals. This healing is based on Kokomi's Max HP.

abilities.name: Nereid's Ascension
_curatorNotes: Ceremonial Garment is a 10s duration self-buff (not a spawned entity) applied to Kokomi on Q cast; it is cleared immediately when Kokomi swaps off-field (onExitField in burst.go). Buff grants: N/CA/Bake-Kurage DMG bonus scaled on MaxHP; HP restore on N/CA hit for all party members (also MaxHP-scaled); interruption resistance; walking on water. No summons[] entry — no entity is spawned. Reviewer to author the Ceremonial Garment self-buff representation and duration semantics.
Initial Q hit at burstHitmark=49 frames (49/60 ≈ 0.82s from cast). Not authored as an effect — consistent with other burst damage entries.

A1 (Tamakushi Casket): if Bake-Kurage is active when Q is cast, Bake-Kurage duration resets to 12.5s (implemented via c.a1() called at frame 46 in burst.go). No schema representation needed — mechanic is upstream of the planner.
abilities.description:
Summons the might of Watatsumi, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents, before robing Kokomi in a Ceremonial Garment made from the flowing waters of Sangonomiya.

Ceremonial Garment
·Sangonomiya Kokomi's Normal Attack, Charged Attack and Bake-Kurage DMG are increased based on her Max HP.
·When her Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents, Kokomi will restore HP for all nearby party members, and the amount restored is based on her Max HP.
·Increases Sangonomiya Kokomi's resistance to interruption and allows her to walk on the water's surface.

These effects will be cleared once Sangonomiya Kokomi leaves the field.

passives.name: Tamakushi Casket
passives.description: If Sangonomiya Kokomi's own Bake-Kurage is on the field when she uses Nereid's Ascension, the Bake-Kurage's duration will be refreshed.

passives.name: Song of Pearls
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-11 (E2 follow-up): authored as 2 effects (normalDmgBonus + chargeDmgBonus, each scaling on healingBonus at ratio 15) on the burst window. Bound to onCast burst with duration: 10 — matches the Ceremonial Garment's 10s duration, which is when this A4 add-on actually applies.
`healingBonus` was added to the ScalingStat union in this same pass (E2 follow-up) so the value can be authored as a proper scaling form rather than `unknown`.

The base burst buff (N/CA/Bake-Kurage DmgBonus scaled on MaxHP, granted by Ceremonial Garment) is still NOT authored — see the burst's curator notes. This A4 is the +15%×HealBonus add-on layered on top; the base buff is a separate authoring task.
passives.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, the Normal and Charged Attack DMG Bonus Sangonomiya Kokomi gains based on her Max HP will receive a further increase based on 15% of her Healing Bonus.

constellations.name: At Water's Edge
_curatorNotes: trigger: 'manual' is inherited from generator; reviewer to replace. In gcsim (cons.go), c1() fires when NormalCounter == NormalHitNum-1 (i.e., on the final N3 hit) and kokomiburst is active — likely trigger: 'onHit' with ability: 'normal', condition: final hit in combo + burst active. DMG is 30% MaxHP, not Normal Attack DMG (AttackTagNone in gcsim). Gcsim TODO notes gauge is assumed 1A (not specified).

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C1 At Water's Edge — effects[0] (damage 30 hp, hydro) RE-TRIGGERED and RE-HOMED onto the burst ability. ⚓ A proc is armed by the CAST that hosts it: `armCastProcs` (`sim/run.ts`) is handed `variant?.effects ?? active.effects` and never sees a constellation entry, so an effect authored here would be armed by nothing. The constellation gate travels with the effect's own `conditions` instead (the Faruzan C6 precedent). gcsim: `kokomi/cons.go:12-41` — `c1()` is called from `attack.go:71-73` only when `NormalCounter == NormalHitNum-1` (N3) and `kokomiburst` is live; it queues a separate attack, `AttackTagNone` / `ICDTagNone`, Hydro, Durability 25, `Mult: 0`, `FlatDmg = 0.3 × MaxHP`, at `attackHitmarks[2] + travel` — the same instant the N3 itself lands. gcsim's gauge is an assumed 1A (its own TODO), `AttackTagNone` so this is not Normal Attack DMG, `Mult: 0` with the whole magnitude in `FlatDmg`, and that `armedFor: 10` is the Ceremonial Garment and not the ability's length. ⚠️ ⚠️⚠️ `procCooldown` is **forced by lint B.13b** ("an onHit damage effect with application[] needs procCooldown") and **neither gcsim nor the kit states one** — gcsim's only gate is `NormalCounter == 2`, which `filter.hitIndex: 2` already expresses exactly. `1.8` is not invented: it is the minimum N3→N3 cycle off our own frame map (N1→N 14 + N2→N 30 + N3 anim 65 = 109f), so it suppresses no legitimate fire. ⏭ Nate's call — either take that derivation or exempt a `hitIndex`-pinned proc from B.13b. `frame: 0` because gcsim queues the fish at `attackHitmarks[2] + travel`, the same frame the N3 lands, and Kokomi's normals already carry `projectile: {normal: true}` so our hit record is at release + flight too.

constellations.name: The Clouds Like Waves Rippling
_curatorNotes: `recipientHpBelow` primitive shipped 2026-05-11 (queue item 2 alongside Noelle A4 migration). The condition gate is now expressible: `recipientHpBelow: 50`. However the EFFECT SHAPE remains unresolved — the in-game text describes 'Healing Bonuses' valued at 4.5% / 0.6% MaxHP, which is ambiguous between (a) heal-amount add-ons (two `heal` effects scaled on `hp` at ratio 4.5 / 0.6) and (b) Healing Bonus stat buffs (two `buff stat: healingBonus` effects with those values). The latter doesn't match typical healingBonus magnitudes (usually 25–50%) and the values are scoped to specific heal sources (Bake-Kurage vs N/CA) which a stat buff can't gate. Verify against gcsim source before authoring; both interpretations have substantially different schema shapes.
Original placeholder retained for now: `buff hp% 50` is the schema-mismatch artifact (the 50 is the HP threshold, not a buff value).

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 The Clouds Like Waves Rippling — effects[0] (buff hp% 50) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: The shape ambiguity the node flags is **resolved**: both halves are heal-AMOUNT add-ons, not Healing Bonus stat buffs. `kokomi/skill.go:109-119` — inside `skillTick`, `if Cons >= 2 && active.CurrentHPRatio() <= 0.5 { src += 0.045 * maxhp }`. `kokomi/burst.go:131-137` — inside `makeBurstHealCB`, per party member, `if Cons >= 2 && char.CurrentHPRatio() <= 0.5 { src += 0.006 * c.MaxHP() }`. Replace the "EFFECT SHAPE remains unresolved" paragraph with the two gcsim citations above; keep that the two values are add-ons to their base heals and not standalone heals, and that the burst half's base (the Ceremonial Garment N/CA heal) is still unauthored. ⚠️ ⚠️ The second effect's base heal does not exist in our data — the burst's own notes say the Ceremonial Garment heal was never authored — so the C2 add-on stands alone as Kokomi's only N/CA heal claim, which UNDER-states the source rather than over-stating it. ⚠️ Without the Garment gate the N/CA half claims healing on any swing; that is invisible (heal has no planner surface) but is a real Team Builder over-claim. ⛔ Do not reach for `healingBonus` — gcsim adds to `HealInfo.Src`, not to the stat.

constellations.name: Sango Isshin
_curatorNotes: Effect (hydroDmgBonus: 40, duration: 4) looks correct — 40% Hydro DMG Bonus for 4s. trigger: 'manual' inherited from generator; reviewer to replace. In gcsim (cons.go), c6() fires inside makeBurstHealCB when burst active and any party member's HP ratio ≥ 0.8 — likely trigger: 'onHit' with condition burst active + party member ≥80% HP healed.
2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: deleted the second effect (stat: 'hp%', value: 80), which was a generator misinterpretation of the ≥80% HP threshold condition as an HP% buff.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 Sango Isshin — effects[0] (buff hydroDmgBonus 40) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `kokomi/cons.go:70-88` — `c6()` is called from inside `makeBurstHealCB` (`burst.go:148-150`), i.e. on a Normal or Charged Attack hit while `kokomiburst` is live; it walks the party for anyone at `CurrentHPRatio() >= 0.8` and adds `HydroP = .4` for 480f (8s in gcsim vs the kit's 4s). Keep the 480f-vs-4s divergence and that the kit number was taken; keep the 2026-05-09 record that the deleted `hp% 80` sibling was the ≥80% threshold misread as a buff. ⚠️ The Ceremonial Garment is NOT expressible — Kokomi's burst opens no state, carries no `activeDuration`, and `afterBurst` is an untracked state that `stateIndex` leaves `null`, so gating on it would change nothing. Consequence: a rotation with normals and no `Q` draws a false bar, which the caveat names. The alternative considered and rejected: `onCast burst` + `duration: 10` (the A4 "Song of Pearls" Garment pattern already in this file) — it gets the gate right and the trigger wrong, and it draws a false 10s bar on the very common `E Q swap` off-field rotation. ⚠️ `recipientHpAbove` does not exist in the Condition union, so the ≥80% gate has no encoding; it is near-always true in play and is deliberately left out of the caveat under the name-the-pixel rule.
constellations.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, Sangonomiya Kokomi gains a 40% Hydro DMG Bonus for 4s when her Normal and Charged Attacks heal, or would heal, any party member with 80% or more HP.
constellations.caveat: The Hydro DMG bar is drawn on every Normal and Charged Attack; in game it needs the Ceremonial Garment, so it only applies inside her burst window.
